title: Parables of the Bridesmaids, Talents, and Judgment

questions.question: In the Parable of the Ten Virgins (or bridesmaids), what did the five foolish virgins fail to do?
options: They took their lamps but took no oil with them
They fell asleep during the wedding feast
They forgot their wedding garments
They went to the wrong house
questions.correctAnswer: They took their lamps but took no oil with them
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:3 (ESV): "For when the foolish took their lamps, they took no oil with them,"

questions.question: What happened at midnight while all the virgins were slumbering and sleeping?
options: There was a cry, "Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him."
Thieves broke in and stole their oil
The feast was declared over
A great storm arose
questions.correctAnswer: There was a cry, "Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him."
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:6 (ESV): "But at midnight there was a cry, 'Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him.'"

questions.question: When the foolish virgins asked the wise virgins for oil, what did the wise reply?
options: "Since there will not be enough for us and for you, go rather to the dealers and buy for yourselves."
"Take some of ours, for we have plenty."
"You cannot have ours, for you did not pay for it."
"We cannot give you oil, but we will relight your lamps."
questions.correctAnswer: "Since there will not be enough for us and for you, go rather to the dealers and buy for yourselves."
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:9 (ESV): "But the wise answered, saying, 'Since there will not be enough for us and for you, go rather to the dealers and buy for yourselves.'"

questions.question: While the foolish virgins were away buying oil, the bridegroom came. They later knocked on the door saying, "Lord, lord, open to us." How did he respond?
options: "Truly, I say to you, I do not know you."
"You are too late, go back to your homes."
"Welcome, though you are late, enter the joy."
"Depart from me, you workers of lawlessness."
questions.correctAnswer: "Truly, I say to you, I do not know you."
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:12 (ESV): "But he answered, 'Truly, I say to you, I do not know you.'"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Talents, a master goes on a journey and entrusts his property to three servants. How many talents did he give to them?
options: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his ability
He gave them ten talents each
To one he gave a hundred, to another fifty, to another ten
He gave them one talent each to see what they would do
questions.correctAnswer: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his ability
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:15 (ESV): "To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his ability. Then he went away."

questions.question: What did the servant who received one talent do with it?
options: He went and dug in the ground and hid his master's money
He traded it and made one more talent
He spent it on wine and reckless living
He gave it to the moneylenders for interest
questions.correctAnswer: He went and dug in the ground and hid his master's money
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:18 (ESV): "But he who had received the one talent went and dug in the ground and hid his master's money."

questions.question: When the master returned, what did he say to the servant who traded his five talents and made five more?
options: "Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a little; I will set you over much. Enter into the joy of your master."
"You have done adequately. Here is your wage."
"Give me the ten talents and return to your duties."
"You should have made ten more talents, for the market was good."
questions.correctAnswer: "Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a little; I will set you over much. Enter into the joy of your master."
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:21 (ESV): "His master said to him, 'Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a little; I will set you over much. Enter into the joy of your master.'"

questions.question: How did the servant with one talent describe his master to justify his actions?
options: "Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you scattered no seed..."
"Master, I knew you were generous and would not mind if I hid it."
"Master, I thought you were testing my ability to save."
"Master, I knew you would not return for a long time."
questions.correctAnswer: "Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you scattered no seed..."
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:24 (ESV): "...'Master, I knew you to be a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you scattered no seed, so I was afraid...'"

questions.question: What did the master call the servant who hid his talent?
options: "You wicked and slothful servant!"
"You foolish and ignorant slave!"
"You thief and liar!"
"You ungrateful coward!"
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:26 (ESV): "But his master answered him, 'You wicked and slothful servant! You knew that I reap where I have not sown...'"

questions.question: What was done with the one talent taken from the wicked servant?
options: It was given to him who has the ten talents
It was cast into the sea
It was distributed to the poor
It was given to the bankers
questions.correctAnswer: It was given to him who has the ten talents
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:28 (ESV): "So take the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents."

questions.question: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, He will sit on His glorious throne and separate people one from another as a shepherd separates what?
options: The sheep from the goats
The wheat from the chaff
The good fish from the bad fish
The wolves from the flock
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:32 (ESV): "Before him will be gathered all the nations, and he will separate people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats."

questions.question: Where will He place the sheep and where will He place the goats?
options: He will place the sheep on his right, but the goats on the left
He will place the sheep in the pen, and the goats in the wilderness
He will place the sheep on his left, but the goats on his right
He will place the goats on the altar, and the sheep in the field
questions.correctAnswer: He will place the sheep on his right, but the goats on the left
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:33 (ESV): "And he will place the sheep on his right, but the goats on the left."

questions.question: The King will say to those on His right, "Inherit the kingdom prepared for you." Why? What had they done?
options: For I was hungry and you gave me food, thirsty and you gave me drink, a stranger and you welcomed me, naked and you clothed me, sick/in prison and you visited me
For you prophesied in my name
For you gave two tithes to the temple
For you fought boldly in my armies
questions.correctAnswer: For I was hungry and you gave me food, thirsty and you gave me drink, a stranger and you welcomed me, naked and you clothed me, sick/in prison and you visited me
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:35-36 lists the righteous acts towards the vulnerable, which the King considers done to Himself.

questions.question: When the righteous ask, "Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you?", what does the King answer?
options: "Truly, I say to you, as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me."
"You saw me in spirit, and your heart answered."
"Whenever you prayed to me, you fed me."
"It is written in the book of life, though you forgot."
questions.correctAnswer: "Truly, I say to you, as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me."
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:40 (ESV): "And the King will answer them, 'Truly, I say to you, as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.'"

questions.question: For those on His left (the goats), they did not do these things for the least of these. Where will they go away to?
options: Into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life
Into a fiery furnace for a thousand years
Into the outer darkness until they repent
Into the abyss where they will be annihilated
questions.correctAnswer: Into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:46 (ESV): "And these will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life."

key_verse_text: And the King will answer them, "Truly, I say to you, as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me."
